scope: Finite HATCH/MPOLYGON OCS-to-WCS dot products where common-scale normalization underflows a nonzero coordinate before larger terms cancel.

finding.priorBehavior: Dividing every coordinate by the largest magnitude could underflow a nonzero small component to zero. If the other terms then cancelled, the returned finite WCS result silently omitted that component.
finding.change: Detect a nonzero coordinate lost during scale normalization. Recompute the bounded OCS basis products in the original exponent range, combine an opposite-sign product pair first, then use compensated accumulation and fused product residuals.
finding.scopeBoundary: This fallback is reached only when common-scale normalization loses a nonzero coordinate. It does not establish exact arithmetic for every finite vector or change HATCH/MPOLYGON source data.

generatedControl.proof: The X and Z products cancel exactly in WCS X; they sum to a finite WCS Y. Common normalization by 1e308 erases the nonzero 1e-100 local Y coordinate, which maps directly to WCS Z.

unresolved: Correct rounding for every finite OCS input is not established.
Native CAD rendering, external producer behavior and broader 3D consumer qualification remain open.
claimEffect: Closes only the generated underflow-after-cancellation case for the HATCH/MPOLYGON OCS coordinate helper. No DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
